title: Define the adopt/adapt/map method and mapping relationship types
requirements:
- Define how national elements (including those in other frameworks/notations) are mapped to reference elements
- Define 'adoption' unambiguously and separate the overall measure from the specific pathway
- Point to the section that actually describes the approach and check related Chapter 4 cross-references
- Describe criteria for prioritising gaps (impact, dependency centrality, risk, equity, cost, readiness)
- Distinguish full realisation from partial, broader, narrower or related correspondence, and say how each counts toward coverage
- Define adopt/adapt/map at or before first use (3.7.1) or cross-reference 3.7.5
- Record a mapping type and rationale per element (adopted, adapted, replaced, deferred, excluded)
- State that the three pathways can coexist within one national architecture at element level
